expect.notes: --resume of a missing session gives a pre-init result (error_during_execution, num_turns 0, errors 'No conversation found ...') that echoes the requested UUID. A pre-init rejection never confirms identity or opens (C2 §2 delayed identity); a definite missing-session rejection is StartRejected::SessionGone, i.e. submit_failed, and the same VIA session is kept (packet §2). No init was read, so the instance reports vendor_version null (C2 §5). C2 does not say whether a Rejected outcome carries cleanup evidence, so cleanup is unsettled.
